component.name: FidoKeeper
component.summary: FIDO2 安全密钥管理工具
FIDO2 安全金鑰管理工具

description.p: FidoKeeper manages FIDO2 authenticators over USB HID and NFC: browsing and deleting credentials, changing the PIN, and enrolling or removing fingerprint templates.
FidoKeeper 通过 USB HID 与 NFC 管理 FIDO2 认证器：查看和删除凭证、更改 PIN、录入或删除指纹模板。
